unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by connecting enterprise workflow adoption with usage-based forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
- bul_unify_005: Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.

narrative_sentence: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to transform governed agentic AI architecture into an industrialized commercial engine, aligning platform direction, reusable IP, and disciplined enterprise deployment so regulated clients could adopt scalable capabilities through a repeatable operating model.
